name: Himitsu Sentai Burning Bunny
original_name: 秘密戦隊バーニングバニー
source:
I am 17-year-old girl Hiromi Satomi and warrior of justice! The Imperial Technical University is plotting intrigues. But I can deal with any incident after changing into battle form.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
我是十七岁的女孩Hiromi Satomi，也是正义的战士！帝国技术大学正在暗中策划阴谋。不过，只要变身为战斗形态，任何事件我都能解决！

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
